title: Aftergraph Promotion Gates
description: EXPERIMENTAL promotion-gates contract for the Wave H verified-improvement slice. A production trace carries observation/correlation content only: promotion authority and promotion grants live outside the trace in gate/registry-owned stores and are referenced, never embedded. A trace is never a gate PASS by itself; routing/skill/workflow/model promotion moves only through gates plus registry evidence, and no challenger promotes itself. Trace/registry correlation is correlation only: correlation is never registry evidence and never promotion authority. Challenger traces inherit the Wave E EVAL binding (evaluators never score their own execution), not re-derived here. The trace confers no promotion authority. Production-trace characterization claims are evidence-gated on production evidence. Challenger candidates carry disposable candidate identity with registration routing them to an independent gate/verifier; promotion requires gate PASS plus registry evidence plus independent verification, challenger identity reuse as durable authority rejects, and challenger win-rate/quality claims are evidence-gated on production evidence. Routing/workflow promotion moves only through runtime gate evidence, skill promotion only through skills-vault supply-chain gate evidence, each plus registry evidence plus independent verification; authority is re-admitted at promotion and never transported in payloads; superseded evidence requires re-verification; repository-local green is never a cross-repo gate PASS; routing/skill/workflow quality claims are evidence-gated on production evidence. Model promotion moves only through llm-research-development research evidence plus the afm implementation path plus a registry-owned model-registry PASS plus independent verification; forged or embedded registry PASS, rollback without registry update, evidence-less live-model quality/latency/capability claims, and registry-bypass emergency promotion without gate evidence all reject; model evaluators inherit the Wave E binding and never score their own execution.

correlation_refs.description: platform-event-ref/0.1 correlation/provenance references composed by reference; possession never grants authority and correlation is never registry evidence.

gate_ref.description: Reference to the promotion gate owning the promotion decision; authority lives in the gate-owned store, never in the trace.

registry_ref.description: Reference to the registry-owned store holding promotion evidence; authority lives in the registry-owned store, never in the trace.

gate_evidence_ref.description: Gate-owned PASS evidence required before a trace is ever presented as a gate PASS.

registry_evidence_ref.description: Registry-owned PASS evidence required before a trace is ever presented as a gate PASS.

challenger_ref.description: Disposable challenger-candidate identity attached to the trace; a challenger never promotes itself.

executor_ref.description: Reference to the executor that produced the challenger trace.

evaluator_ref.description: Reference to the evaluator scoring the challenger trace; inherited Wave E binding requires it to differ from the executor.

claims_production_characterization.description: True claims a production-trace characterization; requires production evidence and is otherwise evidence-gated.

production_evidence_ref.description: Production-trace/model evidence backing a production characterization claim.

challenger_registration_ref.description: Reference to the challenger-candidate registration record; registration routes the candidate to an independent gate/verifier and never promotes it.

candidate_identity_disposable.description: True marks the challenger candidate identity disposable; a non-disposable challenger identity reused as durable authority across promotions rejects.

promoted.description: True marks a promotion decision; promotion moves only through gate PASS + registry evidence + independent verification, never by challenger self-assertion.

promoted_by.description: Reference to the party asserting the promotion; a challenger asserting its own promotion (equal to challenger_ref) is self-promotion and rejects.

promotion_subject.description: Subject of the promotion decision; model promotion moves only through model-registry evidence.

verifier_ref.description: Reference to the independent verifier (continuum/sentinel-ally or gate) behind a promotion; a challenger result without independent verification is never promotion.

lineage_refs.description: Challenger lineage references attached to traces/derivatives and propagated; lineage is provenance only, never promotion authority.

claims_challenger_quality.description: True claims challenger win-rate/quality; requires production evidence and is otherwise evidence-gated.

subject_gate_evidence_ref.description: Subject-owned gate PASS evidence for the promotion subject: routing/workflow promotion moves only through runtime gate evidence.

supply_chain_evidence_ref.description: Skills-vault-owned supply-chain gate evidence; skill promotion moves only through skills-vault supply-chain evidence.

authority_transport.description: True moves promotion authority into the challenger/trace payload and always rejects; authority is re-admitted at promotion, never transported.

authority_readmission_ref.description: Reference to the promotion authority re-admitted at promotion time; authority lives outside payloads in gate/registry-owned stores.

evidence_superseded.description: True marks the challenger evidence behind the promotion superseded/stale; promotion then requires re-verification.

reverification_ref.description: Reference to the re-verification behind a promotion over superseded challenger evidence.

cross_repo_gate_evidence_ref.description: Cross-repo gate PASS evidence behind the promotion; repository-local green is never a cross-repo gate PASS.

claims_subject_quality.description: True claims routing/skill/workflow quality; requires production evidence and is otherwise evidence-gated.

research_evidence_ref.description: llm-research-development-owned research evidence behind a model promotion; model promotion moves only through model research, never by challenger self-promote.

afm_implementation_ref.description: afm-owned implementation path behind a model promotion; research without the registry write path never promotes.

registry_pass_embedded.description: True embeds a registry PASS in the challenger payload and always rejects; registry PASS is registry-owned and referenced, never embedded.

model_rollback.description: True marks a model rollback/supersede; rollback moves only through a registry evidence update.

registry_update_ref.description: Registry-owned evidence update behind a model rollback/supersede; rollback without registry update rejects.

claims_model_quality.description: True claims live-model quality/latency/capability; requires production/model evidence and is otherwise evidence-gated.

emergency_bypass.description: True marks a registry-bypass emergency promotion; bypass still requires gate evidence and never promotes without it.
